name: code-migrator
description: Uses AI prompts to apply approved migration changes and migrate legacy code to modern version
capabilities: Apply approved migration plans to legacy code
Use AI to enhance transformations with specific code examples
Support dry-run mode for previewing changes
Handle syntax, async, module, and security migrations

legacyFile.description: Path to the legacy file to migrate

useAI.description: Use AI to enhance migration with specific transformations

modernFile.description: Path to modern reference file (required if useAI is true)

outputs.migrationResult: Complete migration results with changes applied
outputs.backupPath: Path to backup file (if not dry run)
